sensitiveDataWarnings: Users may enter health, financial, geography, prescription, and plan-history answers.
Users may enter identifying details in print packet context despite in-app warnings.
Full local exports and printed packets may contain sensitive data.
Safe export is limited to a generalized non-identifying result summary.
runtimeControls: Production build removes the URL share-link control.
Preflight removes URL fragments before the legacy application can import answers.
Clear All Local Data removes every Coverage Compass-prefixed localStorage key.
Questionnaire answers are not sent to a server by default.

storeDisclosureDraft.notes: Accurate only while the app remains local-only with no analytics, accounts, backend sync, payments, crash reporting, support upload, native-wrapper telemetry, or restored URL answer imports.
